name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Brown ground beef. Add tomatoes and simmer. Combine with spaghetti.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Cook chicken. Add curry powder. Pour in coconut milk and simmer.

name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
ingredients: salmon fillets, asparagus, lemon, garlic, olive oil, butter, salt
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a pan. Sear salmon fillets until golden brown. Add butter, garlic, and lemon juice. Cook asparagus in the same pan until tender.
